body: Promote the 1.12.0 MUST (final audits multi-round, <=3 re-audit rounds, no-ship at cap) from prose to mechanical enforcement. Design (A+B, option C rejected): (1) scripts/audit_ledger.py CLI mirroring dispatch_ledger.py (record/gate/status) — audit recipe step 8 records each round (--round N --blockers X --majors Y --gate release) into git-ignored .harness/audit-ledger.jsonl (transient-evidence rule, friction precedent). (2) Stop gate: verify-before-stop.sh step 6 — ledger exists AND red (last release-gated round B/M>0, or Round>=4 cap still red) -> advisory in standard / block in strict, one-shot .harness/audit-ack escape. (3) ship_plugin.sh cmd_land hard gate beside the version-bump gate: ledger red -> refuse merge. Trigger is ledger-exists-and-red — gates enforce that a CLAIMED audit converges, never force audits to happen (cadence/review-tier owns that). Rejected: PreToolUse Bash command matching (brittle; canon keeps behavioral PreToolUse gates unshipped). Honest ceiling: strict-block + session-id audit trail, not cryptographic compliance (friction-gate lesson). Process: adversarial critic panel on the plan before build (critic-before-build-canon).
title: Hook-back the audit Convergence MUST: audit ledger + Stop gate + land hard gate
